name: Aiodify Content Protection
author: aiodify

sections.description:
Protect WordPress content from casual copying with right-click, text selection, keyboard shortcut, image drag, and print protection.

Visit the official AIodify Plugins Page for documentation and specialized WordPress solutions.

🛡️ Key Protection Features:

  • Right-Click Shield: Disables right-click context menus across your site.
  • Text Selection Lock: Prevents mouse dragging, highlighting, and double-click copying.
  • Clipboard Blocker: Traps and prevents copy, cut, and paste events.
  • Keyboard Shortcut Interception:
    • Ctrl+A / Cmd+A (Select All)
    • Ctrl+C / Cmd+C (Copy)
    • Ctrl+X / Cmd+X (Cut)
    • Ctrl+V / Cmd+V (Paste)
    • Ctrl+S / Cmd+S (Save Page)
    • Ctrl+P / Cmd+P (Print Document)
    • Ctrl+U / Cmd+U (View Source)
    • Ctrl+F / Cmd+F (Find in Page)
    • F12, Ctrl+Shift+I/J/C, Cmd+Opt+I/J/C (DevTools / Console / Inspector)
  • Image & Media Protection: Disables dragging images to the desktop or opening them in new tabs.
  • Print Blocker: Blanks out printing or replaces print preview with a copyright warning.
  • Customizable Toast Warning: Display a modern glassmorphic toast notification when unauthorized actions are attempted.
  • Role Exclusions: Bypass protection automatically for logged-in administrators and editors.

🎨 Modern Dashboard:

  • Clean, responsive settings panel with toggle switches.
  • Interactive Live Toast Preview tool to test your warning messages in real-time.
  • Multiple toast themes (Dark Glass, Neon Indigo, Clean Light, Amber Warning) and screen positions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aiodify-content-protection.zip archive directly in your WordPress Admin via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  3. Navigate to Content Guard in your WordPress Admin sidebar to configure your protection settings.
sections.faq:
Can administrators still copy content and use DevTools?

Yes! In the User Exclusions tab, you can enable the administrator bypass option so you and your team can work without hindrance.

Does this affect contact forms or search fields?

No. The protection engine intelligently detects <input> and <textarea> form controls so visitors can still fill out forms and search your site.

Where can I get support or custom solutions?

Visit aiodify.com/plugins for more tools, updates, and specialized WordPress solutions.
